text:
Morgan - People Ops: Sam asked if we can backdate a salary + title for a new hire effective 2026-04-01 but their start is 2026-04-12. what do we need to proceed? cc @Priya @Elena

Sam - Eng Manager: manager wants SWE I -> SWE II and salary bump effective 4/1 to align team budget. candidate signed and start is 4/12.

Elena - Comp Analyst: we can do salary retro with a signed amendment. we prorate by days (daily basis). equity/grant dates shouldn't be backdated without comp/legal OK.

Priya - Payroll: payroll can run a manual retro if docs are in before cutoff (2026-04-25). need signed amendment, comp calc, payroll reason code, and tax note for EMEA. sample command: create_adjustment --eid 012345 --period 2026-04 --retro_start 2026-04-01 --amount <amt> --note "OC retro"

Rosa - HRBP: benefits start remains hire date (4/12). cannot retro-enroll. title in HRIS can reflect 4/1 if paperwork supports it.

Hanna - Legal EMEA: many EMEA countries require employment on the retro period for tax reporting. if they weren't on payroll, we may need to classify as sign-on or seek local clearance. send country and contract copy. include tax liability language in amendment.

Sam - Eng Manager: I'll upload signed amendment and note country (Spain).

Elena - Comp Analyst: I'll post a draft backpay calc once amendment is uploaded. expect daily pro-rate: ((new_old)/365)*days_prior.

Morgan - People Ops: checklist: 1) Sam uploads amendment. 2) Elena posts calc. 3) Priya confirms payroll window. 4) Rosa/Hanna confirm EMEA compliance. I'll close once payroll is authorized.
